name: eight-hour-throttle-longer-reversion
rationale: Under the 8h/8h throttle (best 500,000 JPY static-mix deficit to date, -0.58 on 2026-10-04) the composite is sampled once per 8h block but its reversion family still measures 1-1.5h horizons (rsi60/bb90), so each held value is a snapshot of noise much shorter than the holding period. Lengthening RSI to 2h and Bollinger to 4h lines the signal horizon up with the hold. Unthrottled, longer-reversion-horizons (rsi90/bb120, 2026-09-25) was rejected, but that test paid full turnover cost; this isolates the horizon effect under a throttle where cost is already small. Bollinger 240 fits inside the 300-candle warmup.
